answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation kernel binds each agent to a glacier verifiable delay function, forcing any identity clone to incur a zero-knowledge proof cost exceeding the staked collateral and exposing a unique pigment of stake. The protocol slashes a fixed fraction of the collateral whenever a delayed proof fails, yielding a negative expected attack utility proportional to the slashed amount. This construction establishes a robust Nash equilibrium where honest participation strictly dominates any Sybil forging strategy.
